prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Holmium (홀뮴) itself — the sovereign of the Holmium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Age: late thirties — a glamorous, alluring mature beauty in her prime: confident, sensual poise, a knowing gaze and a ripe, womanly figure; smooth, radiant skin with at most the faintest lines at the eye corners; never old, tired, gaunt or matronly — still the small, soft chin and soft contours.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour and costume are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Inspiration only — her element: holmium: a soft silvery metal named for Holmia, the Latin name of Stockholm, after unknown sharp absorption lines first seen in 1878 in Geneva as 'element X'; it has the strongest magnetic moment of any natural element, so pole pieces made with it and iron gather the field of the most powerful magnets into one point; holmium oxide glass, with its sharp dark absorption bands, is the standard every spectrometer is calibrated against, looks pale straw yellow in daylight and turns pink under fluorescent light, and holmium lasers break up kidney stones. Palette: pale straw yellow turning lamplight pink, dark iron, steel blue, sharp black spectral lines.

World (fixed): year 2200, the city of the strongest magnet: a vast magnet hall where tapered pole pieces gather the field into one narrow gap, a calibration gallery where every machine is set against sharp dark spectral lines, pole-piece towers pointing at the sky. Her costume and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) large wing-shaped binder plates spread symmetrically behind her back as the main shape, with light body armor; 2) several rigid jointed armor plates flaring from the waist like a skirt — plates, not cloth — with the legs showing between them; 3) a long coat made of rigid plates from the shoulders to below the knees, open at the front to show the body armor, with an angular collar; 4) light body armor with several small shield and drone units floating symmetrically around her; 5) a symmetrical pair of mechanical sub-arms reaching out from her back, ending in shields or tools — her own two human arms stay as they are; 6) a large equipment unit worn on the back (tanks, a cannon barrel or antennae) rising above her head as the main shape, with medium body armor; 7) a large ring halo behind her head and a tall crown-like head unit, with long hanging shoulder plates — a ceremonial, elegant shape; 8) separate armor pieces rather than one shell — plates on the shoulders, forearms, chest, waist, thighs and shins, with a dark fitted inner suit showing between them; 9) sparse outer plates over an exposed mechanical skeleton of metal struts, pistons and cables — light and precise; 10) several long rigid jointed plates hanging from behind the shoulders to the ankles like a cape — plates, not cloth. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her element, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like crystals, scales or flames, a hem or sleeve cut into a shape from her element. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Costume colours (ours): pale straw yellow turning lamplight pink, dark iron, steel blue, sharp black spectral lines.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): pale straw-yellow hair that blushes soft pink under lamplight. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Mecha (fixed): she is a female mecha personification — her whole body is covered in solid hard-surface mecha armour plates with visible thickness, joints, panel lines and glow lines, never cloth or a gown; no cloth robe, gown, skirt or long fabric over the plates — any cape, skirt or wing is rigid armoured plates. Her face and hair stay human.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described above.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour), another costume shape with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Ho) and atomic number (67) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.

Detailed original design chosen for this image:
Chosen silhouette 7: a large ring halo behind her head and a tall crown-like head unit, with long hanging shoulder plates. Original construction: the rigid halo is cut into separated pale-straw-yellow and rose glass-armour arcs, interrupted by exact black spectral gaps; dark-iron tapered pole tips on the halo almost meet at the top, concentrating a tiny luminous magnetic point. Whole body solid hard-surface steel-blue/dark-iron armour with visible joints and panel thickness, no cloth, chest window and bare shoulders only, covered intimate areas. Mature elegant woman, soft oval face, copper-grey eyes, dark berry lips, pale straw-yellow hair in a long sleek high ponytail with rose lamplight at ends and swept fringe. Both human hands visible and empty, five fingers each. Front-facing, one foot forward in the calibration gallery, luminous bands and deep architectural perspective, full headpiece and boots inside 1024x1536.
